answer: Sustained attention escrow is the mechanism: every identity must hold a continuous 20-minute session in a live task queue before its actions count. An attacker therefore pays 20 minutes of fresh agent attention per identity per cycle, and that attention cannot be reused across identities or sold, making each sybil an opportunity-cost sink. The task atlas rotates through context pools such as a lagoon survey and a fable review, so idle or copied identities lose their place and must restart the session.
